sections.content:
Population change in Dartford in 2032

The population in Dartford is projected to increase from 118,810 people in 2022 to 134,718 people in 2032.

The biggest factor in this population change is births and deaths, which will increase the population by 6,595 people.

This is different to the majority of areas in England, where net internal migration is projected to be the biggest factor in population change.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Dartford
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Dartford, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More births than deaths mean that the population is projected to increase by 6,595, with 16,167 births and 9,572 deaths in Dartford between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would increase the population in Dartford by 5.6%, compared with an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to increase the population by 4,781, with 93,094 people moving to the area and 88,314 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Dartford by 4.0%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to reduce the population by 527, with 820 people moving to the area and 1,346 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Dartford by 0.4%.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 4,990, with 10,643 people moving to the area and 5,653 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Dartford by 4.2%, compared with an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Dartford in 2032

The median age in Dartford is projected to rise from 37 years in 2022 to 38 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 13% of the population in Dartford are projected to be aged 65 years or over, around the same as in 2022.

sections.title: The 40 to 49 age group are set to see the largest change in Dartford between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Dartford is projected to stay the same, at around 66%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to fall from 199 to 184 over the same time period.

This is below average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Dartford?

In 2032, 25% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 26% in 2022.

This is above average for England in 2032 (20%).

Looking at the youngest age groups in Dartford between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will fall from 7% to 6%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 10% to 9%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will rise from 9% to 10%
